title: Ring Battery Drain in Cold Weather
app: Reolink, UniFi Protect, Ring, Nest Protect, Frigate, and Home Assistant security integrations streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT, webhooks, and vendor APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ring:event
| stats avg(battery_drop_pct_day) as battery_drop_pct_day, avg(outdoor_temp_c) as outdoor_temp_c by device
| where outdoor_temp_c<5 AND battery_drop_pct_day>5
| sort - battery_drop_pct_day
description: Uses Ring battery telemetry telemetry to monitor battery drain rate under cold conditions in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for doorbells or cameras that will die quickly in winter weather, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Ring battery telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Device table of cold-weather battery drain.
grandmaExplanation: It lists battery drain rate under cold conditions so you can spot doorbells or cameras that will die quickly in winter weather before it becomes annoying.
